units.source_text: 他对二女公子说道：“衰秋天色，令人分外增悲。

en.t: He said to the Second Princess, "The fading autumn sky makes one's sorrow all the deeper.

units.source_text: 我为排遣寂寥，前日曾赴宇治察看，

en.t: To relieve my loneliness, I went to Uji the other day to see how things were,

units.source_text: 但见‘庭空篱倒’，满目荒凉，悲伤之情，难于堪忍。

en.t: but I found only an empty garden and fallen fences; everywhere was desolate, and the sorrow was almost more than I could bear.

units.source_text: 回忆当年六条院先父亡故之后，

en.t: When I look back on the time after my late father of Rokujo-in passed away,

units.source_text: 无论其最后二三年间遁世时所居的嵯峨院，或本邸六条院，

en.t: whether it was the Saga residence where he lived in retirement during his last two or three years, or his main residence at Rokujo-in,

units.source_text: 凡是过访之人，无不感慨悲伤，不胜怀旧之情，

en.t: everyone who visited was moved to grief and overcome with memories of the past,

units.source_text: 洒了许多眼泪在庭院草木及池塘流水中而归去。

en.t: and they left after shedding many tears among the garden plants and the flowing waters of the pond.

units.source_text: 在先父身边供职的妇人，不论上下，没有一个不是富于深情的。

en.t: The women who had served near my late father, high and low alike, were all deeply feeling people.

units.source_text: 聚居在院内的诸夫人纷纷离散，各自度送离世出家的生涯去了。

en.t: The ladies who had gathered and lived within the residence scattered one after another, each going off to spend a life withdrawn from the world and devoted to religion.

units.source_text: 身份低微的侍女，更是悲伤叹息，无法慰情，心迷意乱，不顾前后。

en.t: The lower-ranking serving women grieved and lamented even more, unable to console themselves, bewildered and heedless of what might come.

units.source_text: 或远赴山林，或当了庸碌的田舍人，走投无路而彷徨各地者甚多。

en.t: Many went far into the mountains, or became ordinary country folk, or wandered from place to place with nowhere to turn.

units.source_text: 然而等到院宇悉皆荒芜、旧事尽行遗忘之后，反又好了：

en.t: Yet once the mansions had all fallen into ruin and the old days had been entirely forgotten, things somehow improved again:

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣迁入六条院，明石皇后所生许多皇子也来居住，

en.t: Minister of the Left Yugiri moved into Rokujo-in, and many princes born to Empress Akashi came to live there as well,

units.source_text: 昔日的繁华又恢复了。

en.t: and the splendor of former days returned.

units.source_text: 当时沉痛无比的悲哀，经过若干年月，自有消释之时。

en.t: Even the unbearable grief of that time naturally found a moment to fade after some years had passed.

units.source_text: 可知悲哀原是有限度的。

en.t: That shows that sorrow has its limits after all.

units.source_text: 我虽溯说前事，但那时我年事尚幼，未能痛感丧父之悲哀。

en.t: Though I speak of those earlier events, I was still young then and could not deeply feel the grief of losing my father.

units.source_text: 惟有最近与令姐诀别之苦痛，正像一个永无醒时的噩梦。

en.t: Only the recent pain of parting forever from your elder sister is like a nightmare from which there is never any waking.

units.source_text: 同是悲伤人生无常，但此次的悲伤罪过更深，

en.t: It is still grief over the impermanence of human life, but this sorrow bears a deeper sense of sin,

units.source_text: 竟使我担心后世之事呢。”

en.t: until it even makes me fear for the world to come."

units.source_text: 说罢泪下如雨，可见其怀着无限深情。

en.t: When he had finished speaking, tears fell like rain, showing the boundless depth of feeling he carried.

units.source_text: 即使是对大女公子并无深交的人，看了薰中纳言的悲哀之相，也不能漠然无动于衷。

en.t: Even someone who had not been close to the Elder Princess could not remain unmoved at the sight of Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, in such grief.

units.source_text: 何况二女公子自有伤心失意之事，

en.t: How much more so for the Second Princess, who had sorrows and disappointments of her own,

units.source_text: 近来比往常更加悲痛地恋念亡姐的面影。

en.t: and who lately had been longing for the image of her dead sister with even greater pain than usual.

units.source_text: 今天听了薰中纳言这一番话，伤心更甚，只是默默不语，眼泪流个不住。

en.t: Hearing these words from Kaoru today made her sorrow still deeper; she remained silent, and her tears would not stop flowing.

units.source_text: 两人隔帘相对哀泣。

en.t: The two of them faced one another across the curtain and wept in sorrow.
